intro.title: From Kampong Speu to the everyday table
intro.text: LM MANUFACTURING CO., LTD. is developing its instant noodle manufacturing operations in Kampong Speu, Cambodia. We believe useful everyday products begin with thoughtful planning, capable people and attention to each step of production. The images in this preview illustrate the industry; approved photographs of our own facility can replace them later.
